content:
sven: Heads-up — planning a kernel + quant runtime rollout tonight 02:00 UTC. This changes the KV-cache kernel ABI. Proposal: temporary pin old ABI on 10% canaries, run smoke + perf for 30m, then unpin to 50% -> 100% if green. Need signoffs and a clear rollback plan.

maya: ack for window. 02:00 UTC works for infra. Suggest also `max_tokens_cache=0` for canaries to avoid cache-corruption surprises. :+1:

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled by sven for 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z - job id rwd-deploy-8891

anita: rollback recipe ready: `rwdctl runtime rollback --id rwd-deploy-8891` and pin command: `rwdctl runtime pin --model all --runtime abi:v5`

lee: what's our fallback routing if the new ABI misbehaves? we should have CPU-fallback route as a last resort.

sven: plan: routing policy = latency-first, fallback -> model:v1-compat on cpu. Automatic rollback trigger: error spike >0.5% sustained for 2 mins OR memory OOM across >3 hosts. I'll add these thresholds to the release notes.

maya: also enable `quant_regression` telemetry and add an alert to #eng-oncall. that way we get alerted early.

ops-bot: Canary job rwd-deploy-8891 started on pool-dedicated-3 [canary:10%]

deploy-bot: Canary smoke results: p50 latency +3ms, error rate 0.02% — PASS

anita: expanding to 50% now. watch for memory OOMs and KV-cache miss spikes.

ops-bot: Canary expanded to 50% (pool-dedicated-3 -> pool-dedicated-7)

lee: seeing a small uptick in KV-cache misses (~1.4% -> 2.1%) on canaries, expected. continue and keep an eye on p99.

deploy-bot: Rollout to 100% scheduled in 20m unless manual abort by @sven or @maya

sven: if mem OOMs or error spike >0.5% for 2 consecutive mins, abort and run the rollback command above. i'll be on-call during the window.

maya: noted. i've also pinned the image in the registry for quick revert: `registry.redwood/caches/abi:v5-pinned`

anita: added a short rollback checklist to the release notes gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/xxxx — includes `kubectl drain` hints and `rwdctl` commands.

deploy-bot: Rollout completed 02:45 UTC. status: success.

ops-bot: Post-deploy monitors: quant_regression=0, p99 latency +4ms, error rate steady at 0.03%. No automatic rollback triggered. Closing thread.
